description: This file contains functions for retrieving and processing DSL and PTM/ATM line and channel statistics, line info, and related data via JSON-RPC requests, specific to a hardware or network management context.

methods.name: dslhal_getlinestats
methods.description: Retrieves DSL line statistics and populates the provided structure.

methods.name: dslhal_getXRdk_Nlm
methods.description: Retrieves DSL NLM (Noise Margin Level) information.

methods.name: dslhal_getlineinfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed DSL line information including status and rates.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetChannelInfo
methods.description: Retrieves DSL channel information such as status, rates, and profiles.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetChannelStats
methods.description: Retrieves DSL channel statistics including error counts and error rates.

methods.name: get_ptm_link_stats
methods.description: Processes JSON reply to extract PTM link statistics.

methods.name: get_atm_link_stats
methods.description: Processes JSON reply to extract ATM link statistics.
